title: Phenol-chloroform DNA purification
author: Tomasz Suchan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.re6d3he
materials: Discard original tube. The tube contains phenol-chloroform.

steps.title: Prepare DNA for Extraction
steps.instruction: Add SDS and phenol-chloroform to the eluted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 ul of 20% SDS to 100ul eluted DNA

steps.title: Mix and Separate Phases
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture and centrifuge to separate the phases.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature for 5 min at full speed (14,000 rpm)

steps.title: Recover Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new labeled tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipette the aqueous phase (approx 80 ul) to a new labeled tube, ensuring no phenol is transferred

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add salt and ethanol to precipitate the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume Na acetate 3M pH 4.8 or 5.2 (e.g., 8ul for 80 ul DNA solution)
Add 2 volumes 100% EtOH (stored at -20°C) (e.g., 176 ul for a total volume of 264ul)
Note: If starting DNA is less than 264 ng, add a carrier such as tRNA, glycogen, or linear acrylamide

steps.title: Incubate and Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Freeze the sample and centrifuge to pellet the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Place on dry ice for 30 min or overnight at -20°C
Centrifuge at 4°C for 30 min at 14,000 rpm

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with ethanol and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4°C for 5 min at 14,000 rpm

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol, dry the pellet, and resuspend.

substeps.instruction: Pipette out the last drop of EtOH
Speed Vac for 3 to 7 min at room temperature
Resuspend in 20ul of water or Tris 10 mM pH 7.5 or 8.0
